name: pixdcon2
description: pixdcon 2.0: controller for Pixoo64 and Ulanzi/AWTRIX pixel displays (rewrite of pixdcon v1, same repo, image pixdcon2)
author: Markus Barta

scripts.//: Developer notes: PAIMOS knowledge 'guideline pixdcon-2-interfaces' (project PIXD). dev = v2 against fake devices and an in-memory MQTT broker, restarted on every change under src/. test = the three approved kinds only (golden frames, API/MQTT contract, fake-device smoke), together under 60 s. dev and test preload dev/net-guard.js: only loopback is reachable, so no real display, broker or host is ever contacted. The release version is ../version.json (inspr-calver-3), not the version field above.
